title: The Typewriter of the Palatinate
author: Coral Crane
blurb: Oscar Reyes, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
